This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their large heads, with long faces,<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> pointed [[ear]]s,<ref name="Make It Stop" /> and elongated but blunt chins.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[3 BBY]], a member of this species was present on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], walking near the [[Niki-Bon Travel Agency]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> Two years later, a member of this species could be found within the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] while [[Kleya Marki]] infiltrated the building in search of [[Luthen Rael]].<ref name="Make It Stop" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[I Have Friends Everywhere|fifth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Louis Wiltshire]] sometime prior to the production for the season, not for a specific project or franchise, but instead simply as a design to showcase his skills to potential clients on his portfolio website.<ref name="LW Concept">{{EmailCite|email=File:LouisWiltshireAliens-2025-07-19.png|creator=[[Louis Wiltshire]]|date=2025-07-19}}</ref> During the design process for the show, Wiltshire was allowed to use old unaffiliated designs such as this one when tasked with creating a "generic" alien design for the creature department.<ref name="LW Generic">{{EmailCite|email=File:LouisWiltshireAliens-2025-07-20.png|creator=[[Louis Wiltshire]]|date=2025-07-20}}</ref>
